card.name: Unit words before "per" rates
card.fires_on: The first part of a unit or counting word that is about to be followed by "per" in a rate, such as parts, frames, copies, liters or micrograms. It also fires on the middle of unit names like becquerels.

modes.label: Count word before per
modes.description: A counting or quantity noun that is followed by "per" in a rate.
modes.example: Cobalt has an abundance of 25 mg/kg (or<< parts>> per million) in the Earth's crust

modes.label: Partway through unit names
modes.description: A piece inside a spelled-out unit name, where the rest of the unit and "per" come next.

modes.label: Per after a count
modes.description: The word per itself in a particles-per-vial style heading.
modes.example: Vial Particle Number Particles<< per>> vial Maximum Activity

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing a rate or unit expression, such as "per" forms and measure endings.
card.plain: It lights up on a unit or counting word that is about to be followed by "per", as in parts per million.
